_comment: CI thresholds for the conclusion evaluation harness.
PROVISIONAL. These numbers are engineering guard-rails against regression
on a synthetic fixture set. They are NOT evidence for any product claim and
none of them has been validated against human-labelled data.
Product priority is precision over recall: the claim-safety thresholds
conclusion-kind precision, exact-evidence validity) are absolute, while the
recall-shaped thresholds are deliberately permissive because refusing to
conclude is an acceptable outcome and asserting something unsupported is not.
